canDoYue: 你識講批量數量、刻標誌、交貨期，同埋請對方用電郵報價同講價。
canDoEn: Order gifts in bulk, ask about engraving a logo and the lead time, and request a better price and an email quote.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Good morning. Are you looking for a bulk quantity of small gifts with your own logo on the lid?
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨。你係咪想訂一批細禮品，盒蓋有你自己嘅標誌？
dialogue.say: Good morning. Are you looking for a bulk quantity of small gifts with your own logo on the lid?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Yes. We need thirty pieces for the office this month, and we want that logo engraved on each box.
dialogue.glossYue: 係。我哋今個月要三十件畀公司，每盒都要刻嗰個標誌。
dialogue.say: Yes. We need thirty pieces for the office this month, and we want that logo engraved on each box.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: The lead time for that logo engraving is three full weeks after you approve the finished artwork with us.
dialogue.glossYue: 刻標誌嘅交貨期係你確認完稿之後三個星期。
dialogue.say: The lead time for that logo engraving is three full weeks after you approve the finished artwork with us.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could you do a better price for all thirty pieces if we confirm the artwork with you this week?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我哋今個星期同你確認稿，三十件可唔可以有個好啲嘅價錢？
dialogue.say: Could you do a better price for all thirty pieces if we confirm the artwork with you this week?

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: Yes. The better price is forty dollars for each of the thirty pieces if you confirm the order this week.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。今個星期確認訂單，三十件每件四十蚊。
dialogue.say: Yes. The better price is forty dollars for each of the thirty pieces if you confirm the order this week.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Please email that written quote straight to our office, and put the full lead time in that email.
dialogue.glossYue: 請將報價電郵去我哋公司，嗰封電郵寫明成個交貨期。
dialogue.say: Please email that written quote straight to our office, and put the full lead time in that email.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.text: I will hold these small gift boxes in the shop once you approve the artwork and the written quote.
dialogue.glossYue: 你確認完稿同書面報價，我就幫你留住呢批細禮盒。
dialogue.say: I will hold these small gift boxes in the shop once you approve the artwork and the written quote.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will read it tonight and reply soon if the price and the three weeks both suit our office.
dialogue.glossYue: 我今晚會睇，如果價錢同三個星期都啱公司，我好快覆你。
dialogue.say: I will read it tonight and reply soon if the price and the three weeks both suit our office.
